root_config.coordinate_convention: model coordinates; x_world = x_model * coord_scale + target pocket COM
root_config.deviations: common-frame correction; matched SDE all arms; fixed reference ligand atom count; exact CK2 paper window and batch size unreported; no diversity filter during collection

extension.composition_fallback: Unconditioned learned parent mixture for unseen counts; only mathematically undefined observables have zero coordinate dose
extension.conditional_gradient: Hungarian assignments and teacher priors frozen; FLOWR endpoint coordinates differentiated
extension.control_semantics: Old-state Euler control added after native SDE; no exact tilted-density claim
extension.dose_rule: predictive_flow RMS calibrated coordinate VJP, atom/path caps and severe-new-clash checks
extension.gradient_diagnostics: Endpoint and current-state gradients from one reverse graph; no head derivative
extension.gradient_target: Pre-native x_t; detached self-conditioning/correspondence. Lagged post-native injection
extension.preflight_extra_forward_calls: One-time numerical validation only, separately logged
extension.reference_time_alignment: Original score t with actual proposal state t+dt inside learned support; reward forecast at t
extension.reward_derivative_trace: Raw evaluated scalar VJP dot realized injection; preconditioned inner product separate
extension.reward_response: Only first-order directional estimate after injection, not fresh endpoint response
extension.topology_policy: Native atom/bond transitions remain free; no graph equality or ligand pair-distance acceptance gate

root_config.recording: all 100 pre-integration and proposed states, endpoints, scores; all candidates including no-offspring
root_config.selection_mode: Disabled; native categorical sampling only; no particle selection or replication
root_config.trajectory_storage: per-step verified HDF5; consolidated trajectory.h5; verified stage files retired; no raw trajectory NPZ
